    Installation

    Tabular Editor is installed as a single Git package and has no additional dependencies.

    Install with Unity Package Manager

    1. In Unity, open Window > Package Manager.
    2. Click + and choose Install package from git URL....

    1. Enter the following URL and click Install:
    https://github.com/NK-Studio/com.nkstudio.unitytable.git

    To pin version 1.0.0, append its Git tag:

    https://github.com/NK-Studio/com.nkstudio.unitytable.git#1.0.0

    Manifest alternative

    You can add the package directly to the dependencies object in Packages/manifest.json:

    {
  "dependencies": {
    "com.nkstudio.unitytable": "https://github.com/NK-Studio/com.nkstudio.unitytable.git#1.0.0"
  }
}

    Keep the other dependencies already present in your manifest.

    Verify the installation

    After Unity finishes importing and compiling, verify that:

    • Tabular Editor appears in Package Manager.
    • The Console has no package compilation errors.
    • Double-clicking a .csv or .tsv asset opens it in Tabular Editor.

    No additional plugins or dependency-installation steps are required.
